A.label: The question
A.headline: Who are you when nobody's watching?
A.body: Twelve apps track your steps, your sleep, your money. None of them ask how you're really doing inside. AquariOS measures your vitality across 4 dimensions — body, mind, purpose, and connection — and shows you where to focus.
A.cta: Come back to yourself → free pre-registration

B.label: The number
B.headline: You have a vitality score.
B.body: iVi is one number, updated in real time, bringing together your physical, mental, spiritual, and social wellbeing. No scattered charts, no noise — plus a private journal not even our AI can read.
B.cta: Find your iVi → free, no card needed

C.label: The origin
C.headline: Born from a near heart attack. Became a fresh start.
C.body: A dentist with 36 years in practice asked the question that changed everything: "Where did I lose myself?" The answer became the first Personal Operating System for whole-person health.
